hero.title: Malla Reddy University
hero.summary: Malla Reddy University’s School of Agricultural Sciences in Hyderabad offers an agriculture honours bachelor’s degree alongside allied food and horticulture study. Its published learning approach includes rural work experience, industrial attachment, hands-on training and student projects, placing practical activity within a wider university setting.

overview.heading: Agriculture learning at Maisammaguda
paragraphs: MRU’s agricultural sciences school lists the agriculture bachelor’s degree alongside horticulture and food science. The university locates the school at Maisammaguda, Dulapally, in Hyderabad. Its dedicated school pages identify academic practices and provide access points for curriculum, staff and facilities information.

The school describes Student READY components that include rural agricultural work, experiential learning, industrial training and student projects. These components offer useful questions for a campus visit: where students complete each activity, how supervision works and how their work is assessed. The undergraduate eligibility page separately states a relevant-subject 10+2 requirement and marks threshold for agriculture applicants.

admissions.heading: Applying to MRU
admissions.intro: MRU publishes separate eligibility and fee pages. Use the agriculture entry conditions and request an intake-specific selection and cost notice before completing the application.
eligibility_points: The official undergraduate agriculture category states at least 50% in relevant 10+2 subjects.

steps.text: Confirm that your subject combination meets the school’s current requirements.

campus.heading: Agricultural teaching and practical work
campus.intro: The school describes experiential learning, rural attachment, industry training, skills work and projects. A detailed current laboratory inventory could not be verified from the linked pages. A readable official school inventory identifies genetics/plant-breeding, plant-pathology, horticulture and agronomy equipment. Confirm present access and practical schedules with the department.

facilities.name: Genetics and plant breeding laboratory
facilities.description: The official inventory lists seed display boxes, a seed germinator, BOD incubator, hot-air oven, deep freezer and binocular microscope.

facilities.name: Plant pathology laboratory
facilities.description: The official school inventory identifies microscopes, hot-air oven, autoclave and incubator.

facilities.name: Horticulture and agronomy practical equipment
facilities.description: The school page lists garden tools, sprayers and protected structures including shade nets/polyhouses, alongside tillage implements and agricultural hand tools.

practical_learning: The school lists experiential learning and Rural Agricultural Work Experience.
Its published practices include in-plant/industry attachment, skills training and student projects.

scholarships.heading: Scholarships and financial support
scholarships.text: The official eligibility page states that merit scholarships exist across academic programmes. Agriculture-specific award amounts, score bands and renewal conditions were not verified.

placements.heading: Career support and outcomes
placements.text: MRU provides a university placement route, but the agriculture sources used do not establish a dated programme-level employment result. No general-university salary is transferred to the agriculture degree.

recognition.heading: Recognition and programme accreditation
recognition.text: The audited ICAR register identifies Malla Reddy University with validity from 2026-03-16 to 2031-03-15. The programme labels below preserve the register’s scope; other institutional degrees are not covered by inference.

faculty.intro: A dated agriculture faculty roster for MRU has not been verified for this draft.

faqs.question: Where is MRU’s agriculture school located?
faqs.answer: The official school page gives Maisammaguda, Dulapally, Hyderabad, Telangana 500100.

faqs.question: What is the published 10+2 marks threshold?
faqs.answer: The eligibility page states at least 50% for the undergraduate agriculture category, with relevant subjects.

faqs.question: What practical components does the school name?
faqs.answer: Its academic-practices page names experiential learning, RAWE, industry training, hands-on work and projects.

faqs.question: Are horticulture and food science also listed?
faqs.answer: Yes, the school lists them alongside agriculture. Their accreditation must be checked separately.

faqs.question: Which degree is covered by this ICAR record?
faqs.answer: B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture, with the term 16 March 2026 to 15 March 2031.

faqs.question: Is a current agriculture tuition amount verified?
faqs.answer: No. The official fee page is labelled 2025–26, but its programme amounts were not readable in the source used.
